request: Analyze GSE272928 for PMID 40881686 (Distinct NK cell function and gene expression in children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia in remission before and after acute exercise: an exploratory study.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of magnetically isolated circulating NK cells (Illumina HiSeq 2500, PE100), HTSeq raw counts + Cufflinks FPKM (S2.5.p2)
final.samples: 9 B-cell ALL children in remission + 9 age/sex-matched healthy controls, each sampled before (baseline) and immediately after (peak) one acute cycling session = 36 libraries (ABS.p2, S2.5)
final.primary_estimand: Difference between ALL-in-remission and control children in the within-subject NK-cell transcriptome response to an acute exercise bout (group x time interaction, paired by child) (S2.6.p2, S3.p3)
planned_contrasts: group x time interaction: (ALL post-pre) - (CON post-pre), paired (S3.p3; paper: 179 genes, 163 negative / 16 positive, p<0.01, Suppl. Table S3)
baseline ALL vs CON (S3.p2; paper: 284 genes, 124 up / 160 down, p<0.01, Suppl. Table S1) - disease contrast, not an exercise effect
within-group post vs pre in ALL (Suppl. Table S6) and in CON (Suppl. Table S7) (S3.p3; counts not stated in the text)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.38.3 on raw counts, paired design (subject), multifactor design with interaction terms (S2.6.p2)

paper_results.named_genes: IL1B down in ALL post vs pre (log2FC -1.68, p<0.001) but not in CON (-0.18, p=0.59) (S4.p6); TREM1, S100A8/A9/A12 down in ALL only (S4.p4-p5)

final.pathway_method: QIAGEN IPA canonical pathways, FDR<0.05 (S2.6.p2) - proprietary, not reproducible here

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S2.6.p2 define DESeq2 with paired design + interaction terms and raw p<0.01. Results S3.p2 (baseline 284 DEGs) and S3.p3 (interaction 179 genes) give the counts. The exercise question is the within-subject post-vs-pre change and its group difference.

checks: paper S8.p1 and S2.5.p2 name GSE272928
36 GSMs = 18 children x 2 timepoints, 9 ALL + 9 CON, matches ABS.p2
matrix columns ALL02..ALL12, CONT_51..59 x BASELINE/PEAK match GEO titles

ownership.reasoning: The series is the paper's deposit (paper S8.p1, Series_pubmed_id 40881686); the only series supplementary file is GSE272928_transformed_RNA_seq_Data.xlsx (csv copy used), 36 sample columns matching the 36 GSM titles.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix column names were renamed by name (prep/rename_columns.py, ALL02_BASELINE -> ALL_02_BASELINE) so that they equal a key derived from the GEO title (<GROUP>_<NN>_<TIME>; title 'ALL03  PEAK' has a double space, handled by \s+). grp/time/subject come from the title; grp agrees with characteristics 'health status' and time with 'time 1/time 2' (BASELINE=time 1, PEAK=time 2) for all 36 samples.

final.paper_input: DESeq2 on HTSeq raw counts (S2.5.p2, S2.6.p2)

matrix.reasoning: File is named 'transformed'; values are continuous (no non-zero integers), range -4.38..18.9, all-zero genes stored as exactly 0 and near-zero genes at a shared floor of about -4.375 with tiny between-sample spread - the signature of DESeq2 rlog (rlog returns 0 for all-zero rows and shrinks low-count rows to a common value). sum(2^x) per sample is 2.6e7-2.8e7 with SD 2%, consistent with size-factor-normalized counts on log2 scale. GEO data_processing says the submitter produced raw counts (all_merged.txt) but that file is not deposited (sample supplementary_file_1 = NONE; only the transformed xlsx in the series). Not raw counts, so DESeq2 cannot be run; log2-scale input supports limma.

candidates.reason_rejected: VST maps all-zero rows to a positive floor, not 0; the 0/-4.375 pattern fits rlog. Either way the matrix is log2-scale normalized and the method choice is unchanged.

design.subject: subject

final.analysis_type: paired_change (2x2 mixed: group between-subject, time within-subject)
final.formula: per-subject delta = post - pre; ~ 0 + C(grp) on deltas; baseline: ~ grp on pre samples

design.reasoning: S2.6.p2: paired design + interaction terms. The exercise effect is the within-child post-vs-pre change; the paper's headline exercise result is the group x time interaction (S3.p3). Within-group changes (Suppl. S6/S7) are the paper's own secondary results and the direct 'exercise effect' per group. Baseline ALL vs CON (S3.p2) is a disease (associational) contrast reported by the paper; run as secondary. All 18 children have both timepoints.

Group is between-subject; the baseline contrast uses one sample per child so needs no blocking.

final.method: limma (inmoose lmFit + eBayes) on the deposited rlog log2 matrix
final.formula: paired change: delta ~ 0 + C(grp) with contrasts; baseline: ~ grp on pre samples

final.deviation_note: paper's raw p<0.01 applied to limma p-values from the deviation route; BH FDR<0.05 kept as a separate audit rule

threshold.reasoning: S2.6.p2: 'a p-value cut-off of 0.01 was considered statistically significant' with no fold-change rule.

raw p<0.01 with no FDR control as in the paper; FDR audit reported separately
n=9 per group, exploratory study by the authors' own description
